text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—*pant... gasp...*!! 100 meters to 
go...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(If I can just shake "this one" off...! 
I'll win...!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I can win, I can win... I will win...! 
Go, go, go...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh! Dammit, dammit, dammit, 
DAMMIIIT...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Tch. It's only 3 o'clock?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Time to get to work.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Starting today, I've got a Trainer too. 
I'd better get serious about prepping for 
my debut.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (It's finally starting, huh. My...â)

On the day of our very first training 
session after signing a trainer contract 
with Air Shakur—the grounds were buzzing 
with a quiet excitement.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Isn't that person over there 
Shakur-senpai's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Huh?! *That* Shakur-senpai's?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I've seen them get super ticked off 
before... It was so, so scary.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she's so incredibly smart that 
the teachers have trouble handling her 
too...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Becoming that senpai's trainer... That 
person must either have serious guts or be 
ridiculously talented.

Curious gazes begin to gather... Just as 
my heart starts pounding from the 
pressure—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Just tune 'em out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's constant noise all around me. If I 
cared about every little thing, it'd never 
end.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean, even if you're a decorative 
Trainer, it pisses me off when you start 
acting all nervous.
choice_data_list: An ornament...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's right. I don't expect you to 
have any teaching skills.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Today, we're running a simulation to 
prepare for her debut race.
choice_data_list: Simulation?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse, turf 2000m left-handed. 
Weather is cloudy, going is firm...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
These are the optimal conditions for your 
debut match, derived by "Parcae".

"Parcae"—a suite of custom programs, from 
the OS to the applications, built from 
scratch with her debut in mind.

Based on the data Air Shakur collected, 
'Parcae' derives the optimal solution. She 
places absolute trust in this 'partner' of 
hers.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Watch all you want if you feel like it. 
Just don't butt in and run your mouth.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Hmph...!!

Air Shakur takes the inside lane, holding 
back as if lingering at the very tail of 
the pack. As she rounds into the final 
corner—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Take that!!

Accelerating toward the finish line. Her 
running possessed sheer spirit and zero 
waste. There was something undeniably 
captivating in that polished strength.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Whew……
choice_data_list: That was an amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
... With that run, you'd end up around 
fifth place.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Though on the "ultimate route," your 
placing in the debut race doesn't matter.
choice_data_list: When you say "the best route"...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Come. I'll share our upcoming race 
rotation with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Mm, it's on screen.

Air Shakur connects his PC to the monitor. 
The 'Parcae' screen appears... and a 
certain number catches his eye.
choice_data_list:
What does that "991031021222" in the 
bottom right mean?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah... that thing? The heck is up with 
that?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dunno where the hell it came from, but 
it's been showing up ever since we worked 
out the rotation.
choice_data_list: Can that really happen?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ain't nothing unusual. Can't get rid of it 
no matter what, so just leave it be. It 
ain't doing any harm anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, let's talk about your 
race rotation.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—This was the "optimal route" shown by 
"Parcae."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"After the debut race, there's the Hopeful 
Stakes. Then in the Classic Year, the 
Satsuki Sho, the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby), the Kikuka Sho, and the Japan 
Cup."

The Classic Triple Crown—consisting of the 
Satsuki Sho, the Nippon Derby, and the 
Kikuka Sho— is a series of races that can 
only be challenged once in a lifetime.

Those who conquer all are hailed as Triple 
Crown Umamusume, and none can doubt their 
absolute supremacy.
However—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The most important race up to this point 
is the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Parcae" showed that I'd lose the Tokyo 
Yushun by a margin of "7 cm."

It is an absolute figure calculated by 
Parcae. No matter how much one struggles, 
it represents an insurmountable, 
despairing gap to victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I swapped out various data points and 
tried numerous patterns... but to this 
day, those seven centimeters have never 
wavered.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In other words, that's what we call 
"destiny."
choice_data_list: Destiny...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even if I train to my absolute limits and 
reach the theoretical maximum calculated 
by "Parcae"...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"All you can win are the Satsuki Sho and 
the Kikuka Sho. The 7-centimeter 
difference at the Derby won't ever be 
overturned."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A result better than this does not exist 
within 'Parcae'... In other words, in my 
future. However—
choice_data_list:
So we're going to search for it starting 
now, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...In a place that's already been picked 
clean, without a single grain of sand 
left."
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's stuck to the bottom of your 
foot?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's obviously a metaphor. As if I'd make 
such a stupid slip-up in my programming.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And the reason I went through the trouble 
of explaining it so thoroughly is to make 
sure you understand my training policy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
First, we get your stats up to the 
theoretical values needed to win the 
Satsuki Sho and Kikuka Sho. I'm leaving 
part of it to you, so come up with a 
routine.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Forgot your own title, did you?
choice_data_list: Still, calling it an ornament is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: For now, at least.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
However, as an "uncertain factor," there's 
a chance she might prove more useful than 
a mere ornament.
choice_data_list: Uncertain factors?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything that can overturn the 
definitive, perfect 7cm derived from 
mountains of data... the thing you can 
hope for most is a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's ironic, though... Either way, if we 
keep going like this, it's just over.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I will take into account the possibility 
that things might change through your 
intervention.
choice_data_list: I'll do whatever I can!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm tellin' ya, I don't expect a damn 
thing from your abilities."
choice_data_list: I'll do my best to be of help.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I think it's pointless, but... do as you 
wish. So long as it doesn't inconvenience 
me.

At any rate, I've been given an 
opportunity where I might be of use. If 
so, I'd like to consider the future and 
beyond, but...
choice_data_list:
What's the "perfect route" for Senior 
year?

text_block_list.text:
For an instant, a dark shadow fell over 
Air Shakur's eyes. But immediately after—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Do you really need to know that right 
now? Just focus on what's right in front 
of you."
choice_data_list: (That may be true, but...)

text_block_list.text:
It seemed she hadn't told me something 
important yet. And I had a hunch that, as 
her Trainer, it was something I ought to 
know.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...We're done talking. Don't follow me.
choice_data_list:
Will you tell me the answer to that 
question from earlier?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dealing with troubles caused by 
miscommunication is a pain. So if I think 
it's necessary, I'll share it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I ain't got no intention of tellin' ya 
anything else, though. That 7 cm thing, 
too... I ain't gettin' involved in the 
paperwork, and I never planned on tellin' 
anyone.
choice_data_list:
Knowing how you felt was why I formed a 
contract with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, here we go. Smells fishy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even if I answered, what's it to you? If 
all you're gonna say is "huh," it's 
totally pointless.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Or is there somethin' you think you can 
actually do?
choice_data_list:
If you don't know, you can't even begin to 
think about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list:
Better to know now than to be left playing 
catch-up

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: *sigh*

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The 'best route' for the Senior Year, see. 
—It's that you can't win.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Parcae" predicts that after the Kikuka 
Sho, I won't win a single race.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna change a bullshit fate like 
that, you gotta cut it out at the root of 
all evil.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I see it as 'overcoming that 7cm 
difference'."
choice_data_list:
So that's why you're so particular about 
the 7cm, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much ya run, losin' feels 
like crap, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...So, what're you gonna do? Pray for a 
miracle or somethin'?"
choice_data_list: Now I'm even more fired up!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
I'll do everything I can for the sake of 
your victory!
I'll work hard for your victory!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yup, creepy as ever. I'm going home.
choice_data_list: Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Let's change destiny.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't talk about stupid stuff with such a 
straight face.
